newsitem.title: UK: Allen up after recommendation, acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Allen up after recommendation, acquisition.

text.p: Shares in plant UK hire and construction group Allen Plc rose on Monday after a weekend press recommendation and company announced the acquisition of construction group P.S. Turner Holdings.
Allen shares were up 20p at 347-1/2 by 0851 GMT in volume of 85,906 shares.

The Sunday Times "Inside Track" column said Allen's year-end results due on June 23 should show a 30 percent rise in pre-tax profits and that the company was well placed to benefit from a recovery in the housing market.
It said the stock had been trading at a modest multiple to expected 1988 profits, adding that the company was a "high quality play in the sector."

Separately Allen said on Monday it was paying an initial 8.7 million stg for P.S. Turner. It said Turner had grown rapidly in recent years and had an excellent management team, and should benefit from being part of a growing public company.
